class.name: GaeaMaterial
class.brief_description: Data container (or a container of other materials) that tells a [GaeaRenderer] what to draw at a specific point.

method.name: execute_sample
method.description: Recursively samples materials until it finds a data material (see [method is_data]) and returns it. If it fails to find one, returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_resource
method.description: Normally returns itself, but can be overriden with [method _get_resource] to return other materials, depending on behavior wanted. Called once by mapper-type nodes. [b]Note:[/b] This is only used when [method is_sampled] returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_sampled_resource
method.description: Normally returns itself, but can be overriden with [method _get_resource] to return other materials, depending on behavior wanted. Called for every point in a [GaeaSample] by mapper-type nodes. [b]Note:[/b] This is only used when [method is_sampled] returns [code]true[/code].

method.name: is_data
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this material is a data container to be used directly by a [GaeaRenderer].

method.name: is_sampled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this material is sampled for each point in a [GaeaSample].

method.name: prepare_sample
method.description: Recursively calls [method get_resource] until it finds a data/sampled material (see [method is_data] and [method is_sampled]) and returns it. If it fails to find one, returns [code]null[/code].

members.member: Color to be used for previews in the editor (such as in the inspector or the graph).

constants.constant: Maximum amount of loops that [method prepare_sample] and [method execute_sample] can do.
